game.wheel_of_sin_body: Pray for three multipliers on the Wheel of Sin for a bigger win!
game.bonus_games_body: Three sinful bonus games with Divine Prayer Hands and wicked Wilds!
game.unholy_wins_body: Max win of 13 333 times your bet!
game.transition_wicked_ways_desc_1: This bonus game maintains the base game's mechanics and offers a greater chance to reap unholy rewards!
game.transition_wicked_ways_desc_2: Landing additional [[FS]] symbols at the same time during the bonus awards extra free spins.
game.transition_living_on_a_prayer_desc_1: This bonus game maintains the mechanics of the [[WICKED WAYS]] bonus. In addition, all Prayer Hand symbols that appear in this bonus are Divine!
game.transition_living_on_a_prayer_desc_2: Landing additional [[FS]] symbols at the same time during the bonus awards extra free spins.
game.transition_flames_of_fortune_desc_1: This Epic bonus game maintains the mechanics of the [[WICKED WAYS]] bonus offering a greater chance of landing Wild symbols. Each spin guarantees that 1 Divine Prayer Hand symbol lands!
game.transition_flames_of_fortune_desc_2: Landing additional [[FS]] symbols at the same time during the bonus awards extra free spins.

external.about_the_game_desc_1: Scary Mary and Morbid Magda didn’t last long in heaven. Saints they were not, and angels they could never remain. Cast down for their sins, these two fallen sisters have embraced the inferno. Death was just their beginning—they no longer pray for salvation, but to lay claim over the dominion of the damned.
external.about_the_game_desc_2: [[Pray for Three]] is a 5-reel, 5-row cascading game with ways-wins and a max win of 13 333 times your bet. The maximum win can be reached in all game modes.
external.feature_total_win_bar_desc: All wins during each spin are collected in the Total Win Bar outside of the grid.
external.feature_wheel_of_sin_desc_1: The Wheel of Sin is positioned outside the grid. Once activated, each section of the wheel will reveal either an Adding or Multiplying value.
external.feature_wheel_of_sin_desc_2: The three sections of the Wheel can have the following multiplier values:
external.feature_wheel_of_sin_desc_2_section_2: Second section, Adding Multipliers: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x, 333x or Multiplying Multipliers: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20, x33
external.feature_wheel_of_sin_desc_2_section_3: Third section, Multiplying Multipliers: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20, x33
external.feature_wheel_of_sin_desc_3: Activate the Wheel of Sin by landing Prayer Hand or Divine Prayer Hand symbols on the grid during a win. A landed Prayer Hand symbol will reveal a number between 1- 3 which indicates how many sections on the Wheel of Sin will activate. Activated Prayer Hand symbols are removed from the grid, along with other winning symbols. As new symbols drop in, a new Prayer Hand may appear. Only one Prayer Hand symbol can appear on the grid at the same time.
external.feature_wheel_of_sin_desc_4: A landed Divine Prayer Hand symbol will always activate all three sections of the Wheel of Sin.
external.feature_wheel_of_sin_desc_5: If more than one multiplier is active on the Wheel of Sin, the multiplier values will first be combined one by one from left to right. The resulting value is then multiplied by the Total Win Bar amount to form the final payout.
external.feature_wicked_ways_desc_1: Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 [[FS]] scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
external.feature_wicked_ways_desc_2: This bonus game maintains the base game's mechanics with an increased chance of landing both types of Prayer Hand symbols as well as Wilds.
external.feature_wicked_ways_desc_3: Landing additional [[FS]] symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:
external.feature_living_on_a_prayer_desc_1: Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 [[FS]] scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
external.feature_living_on_a_prayer_desc_2: This bonus game maintains the mechanics of the [[WICKED WAYS]] bonus. Throughout this bonus, there is an increased chance of landing Divine Prayer Hand symbols! Prayer Hands do not appear in this bonus.
external.feature_living_on_a_prayer_desc_3: Landing additional [[FS]] symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:
external.feature_flames_of_fortune_desc_1: Activate this Epic bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 [[FS]] scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
external.feature_flames_of_fortune_desc_2: This bonus game maintains the mechanics of the [[WICKED WAYS]] bonus while offering an even greater chance of landing Wild symbols. In addition, each spin guarantees that one Divine Prayer Hand symbol lands!
external.feature_flames_of_fortune_desc_3: Landing additional [[FS]] symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:
external.special_symbols_desc_1: The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.
external.special_symbols_desc_2: In the bonus games, [[FS]] symbols can only land on reels 1, 3 and 5. Only one [[FS]] symbol can land per reel.
external.bonushunt_featurespins_desc: Each spin is 5 times more likely to trigger a bonus game!
external.hail_mary_featurespins_desc: Each spin guarantees a winning combination plus a Prayer Hand or Divine Prayer Hand symbol!
external.wicked_ways_desc: 10 free spins with enhanced base game features!
external.living_on_a_prayer_desc: 10 free spins where all Prayer Hands are Divine!
external.mod_pray_gameinfo_desc: The RTP when buying [[:bonus]] is [[:featurertp]]%. For full information about this feature, see the section above. [[FS]] symbols cannot land in this game mode.
